headline: Iraqi source reveals to Al-Hurra the value of oil smuggled from the stronghold of Kataib Hezbollah
summary: An Iraqi source told Al-Hurra that losses from oil theft operations, including smuggling into Iran, approach two billion dollars annually. The operations are linked to a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold.
why: Iraq's economy depends heavily on oil revenue, and oil theft reduces state income and complicates export controls. Armed-group involvement in oil smuggling raises sanctions and governance risks.
